shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A person who sings, especially professionally.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The singer performed three new songs.

publisher_observation.observation_paraphrase: Cambridge indexes the general countable noun as A2. Frozen B2 teaching sense includes 'especially professionally', which does not establish a distinct B2 sense.

records.editorial_note: The word can describe amateur or professional singers; the original definition's professional qualifier must not be used to manufacture a B2 sense.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: A person who sings songs, sometimes as a job.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The singer rehearsed before the concert.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Water in the form of gas, especially when heated.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Steam rose from the bowl of soup.

publisher_observation.indexed_part_of_speech_and_sense: noun [U], hot gas produced when water boils
publisher_observation.observation_paraphrase: Cambridge indexes the uncountable boiling-water noun at B2. Frozen wording 'water in the form of gas' is broader; everyday visible steam can include condensed droplets.

records.editorial_note: Keep steam noun separate from steam verb, cooking uses, STEAM educational acronym and figurative idioms.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: Steam rose from the kettle as the water boiled.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A person in charge of a military group or operation.
shortlist_snapshot.burmese_meaning: စစ်ဘက်ဆိုင်ရာ အမိန့်ပေးခေါင်းဆောင်
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The commander explained the safety plan to the unit.

publisher_observation.indexed_part_of_speech_and_sense: noun [C], officer in charge of a military operation or naval rank
publisher_observation.observation_paraphrase: Cambridge indexes an officer leading a military operation or holding a naval rank at C2. Frozen B2 says a person leading a military group or operation; the overlap is substantial but the naval rank must not be silently equated to every group leader.

records.editorial_note: Cambridge entry also covers a particular naval rank. Do not conflate a military leader, a naval rank and a non-military team leader.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Completely correct or precise, without approximation.
shortlist_snapshot.burmese_meaning: အတိအကျဖြစ်သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Please record the exact weight of each package.

publisher_observation.indexed_part_of_speech_and_sense: adjective ACCURATE, completely correct in every detail
publisher_observation.observation_paraphrase: Cambridge indexes the accurate adjective at B1. Frozen B2 definition and weight example use that same sense; exact as a formal verb is separate.

records.editorial_note: The verb exact (demand or obtain) is a separate part of speech and cannot justify the B2 adjective.
